solicitations.title: Base Information Technology Support Services
solicitations.agency: Dept of the Army, MICC Fort Carson
solicitations.description: The U.S. Army requires information technology support services including help desk operations, network administration, and cybersecurity policy alignment for Fort Carson. Contractors shall provide personnel in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement. NAICS 541512 applies. See attachments for labor categories and evaluation criteria.

solicitations.title: Avionics Test Equipment Engineering Services
solicitations.agency: Dept of the Air Force, AFLCMC Robins AFB
solicitations.description: The Government intends to award a single contract for engineering services supporting sustainment of avionics test equipment at Robins AFB. The effort includes obsolescence analysis, test program set development, and depot engineering support. See the attached statement of work for deliverables and period of performance.
